objective: Single-writer commit lease so the self-commit sweep never races manual/agent commits and never sweeps foreign in-flight work under a generic message.

semantics: claim_commit_lease returns None when a fresh foreign lease exists (defer, not overwrite)
release_commit_lease unlinks only when owner matches; foreign release leaves the lease intact
expired lease is ignored by commit_lease_active and can be reclaimed
run_once returns 'commit-lease-held:<owner>' before staging when a foreign lease is active
the sweep claims its own lease (actor owner) before git add/commit and releases in finally

manual: first owner claim -> lease path returned
run_once under foreign lease -> 'commit-lease-held:agent-1' / 'in-progress' while real concurrent op held
owner release -> lease removed; run_once proceeds to commit

pytest.note: one earlier xdist run hit an environmental subprocess-reader-thread stall; rerun -n 0 deterministic pass

fail_closed: foreign active lease -> sweep defers (no staging, no commit)
lease I/O errors -> treated as no lease only on read; claim writes are explicit
expired lease never blocks; stale owner cannot resurrect
residual: 10.69-E(1) coordinator-only push / ahead==0 convergence still open
